title: Portolan Registry Catalog Entry
description: Schema for registering STAC catalogs. Submitters provide the catalog URL and a contact address; every other field is auto-extracted from the catalog.

url.description: The URL of the STAC catalog root.

submitter_email.description: Address of the party answerable for this registration, used to report validation failures. This is a registry field, separate from the maintainer contact the Portolan spec requires on a collection's host provider: a catalog may satisfy that requirement with a URL and no address, and the two parties need not be the same.

bbox.description: Auto-extracted bounding box from collections, [west, south, east, north] or [west, south, min_alt, east, north, max_alt]

licenses.description: Auto-extracted license mix: identifier -> number of collections declaring it. The identifier is whatever the collection declares, an SPDX id or a STAC convention such as 'proprietary' or 'other'. Collections declaring no license are the difference against collection_count.

spec_version.description: Auto-extracted Portolan specification version, parsed from the versioned schema URI in the catalog's stac_extensions

spec_version_mixed.description: Auto-detected: true when objects beneath the root declare more than one Portolan version

updated.description: Auto-extracted from the catalog's own top-level `updated`

first_registered.description: When this entry file was added to the registry, from git history

item_count.description: Auto-extracted count of items across collections

asset_count.description: Auto-extracted count of assets across collections

total_size_bytes.description: Auto-extracted sum of file:size across assets

last_crawled.description: When the catalog was last crawled for metadata

status.description: Current validity state from periodic re-validation

last_validated.description: When catalog was last validated for reachability

stale_since.description: When catalog first became stale (null if valid)

failure_reason.description: Reason for validation failure (null if valid)
